srList.sentence: Patients and methods Study design This was a pragmatic, multicentre, randomized (1 : 1 : 1 allocation), open-label, parallel-group medical device trial performed in eight hospitals (three university or teaching hospitals and five general hospitals) in Belgium, including patients on both ICU and non-ICU wards, with patients in ICU limited to < 25.

srList.sentence: Randomization and blinding Patients were centrally randomized to study groups based on a 1 : 1 : 1 allocation: experimental group 1 ( Allevyn(r ) brand) , experimental group 2 ( Mepilex(r ) brand ) and the control group ( SOC) .

srList.sentence: Participants The sample-size calculation was based on the results of several randomized trials with an incidence of 6 of PU category 2 or worse on the sacrum, greater trochanter and heels in the standard of care (SOC) group, 4 and the treatment group having a 50 reduction in incidence of PUs of category 2 or worse. 2 , 22 To have 80 power to detect a reduction in PU incidence from 6 to 3, data had to be available for 1578 patients in total, of whom 526 had to be allocated to the control group and 1052 to the treatment group.
